title: DoS due to Chainlink oracle returning wrong data or going offline
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  Chainlink oracle price feed can return wrong data or go offline in extreme cases, which will provoke the `EthPriceFeed.fetchEthPrice()` function to revert. This function is called to execute the main actions of the system, such as redeeming collateral, opening a position, adding collateral, closing a position, claiming escrow, and liquidating a position.
